prompts.pulse: Use case: logo-brand. Create a standalone brand identity study for TASTIQ, an entertainment discovery brand helping adults find a game, film, series or animation that fits their current mood. This is a fresh independent identity, NOT a logo matched to an existing website. Direction "Pulse": custom thick lowercase wordmark, exact text "tastiq", soft confident rounded sans letterforms, broad friendly bowls, high optical quality, surprising but legible last q. The lowercase q has an integral short diagonal descending terminal, visibly a q, not an o with a separate colored ribbon. Design one bespoke coherent wordmark; the q can function as a compact standalone monogram. No other symbol to the left of the main wordmark. Color world: saturated electric royal blue #2649F5, acid lemon #EDFF57, pure white, pure black. No warm beige, copper, terracotta, brown, paper texture or charcoal website palette. Clean landscape 3:2 presentation: upper 60 percent is PURE WHITE with the very large blue wordmark as the hero, generous clear space; lower left is a full flat electric blue field with a lemon standalone q and small white wordmark; lower right is pure white showing a strictly BLACK ONE-INK version of the SAME wordmark, plus a tiny black q. One simple palette strip using the blue, lemon and white is acceptable. Keep repeated letterform outlines consistent across versions. Flat crisp vector-style artwork, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no mock product/app UI, no existing website, no marketing copy, no labels, no slogans, no numbers. Text only tastiq. Not a food brand, no tongue/smile/play triangle/game controller/film reel/AI sparkle. Sophisticated, vivid, recognisable at small scale. A real letterform design rather than a typed generic font.
prompts.editorial: Use case: logo-brand. Create a standalone, personality-rich identity study for TASTIQ, a contemporary cultural entertainment curator for adults choosing games, films, series and animation. Independent brand, no website reference. Direction "Editorial": exact lowercase text "tastiq" rendered in a bespoke very bold expressive SOFT SERIF wordmark. Sculptural bracketed serifs, lively rhythm and distinctive beautiful q with a flowing strong descender; slightly eccentric cultural-magazine personality, high legibility, not thin luxury fashion, not a bakery. This must look categorically different from rounded sans lettering. The main logo is ONLY the wordmark, without quotation marks or any separate generic pictogram. Its compact emblem is a bespoke lowercase t taken from the lettering with a decisive curved serif foot, no Q monogram. Color world: deep vivid violet #5422A8, clear candy pink #FF95C8, pure white, pure black. No warm off-white/beige, no copper or terracotta, no brown, no existing website colors. Clean landscape 3:2 board. Upper 60 percent: pure WHITE with a very large violet wordmark, generous negative space. Lower left: saturated VIOLET field with a pink t monogram and a small white wordmark. Lower right: pure white with the SAME lettering in strict BLACK ONE-INK plus a small black t monogram. A simple violet/pink/white palette strip is acceptable. All repeated letter shapes must stay consistent. Crisp flat vector-style shapes. No gradients, shadows, texture, app UI, merchandise photography, slogans, captions, numbers, fake brand claims. Text only tastiq. Avoid quotation marks resembling 69, generic speech bubbles, food symbolism, play buttons, controllers, reels, stars or AI sparkles. It should feel joyful, discerning, human, visually self-sufficient.
prompts.signal: Use case: logo-brand. Create a self-contained standalone logo identity study for the adult entertainment discovery brand TASTIQ. It recommends a fitting game, film, series or animation; brand concept: making a clear choice from many options. Direction "Signal": a compact bold architectural MATCH EMBLEM and custom condensed uppercase wordmark exact text "TASTIQ". Two solid opposing offset bracket forms nest to create one memorable single near-square emblem with a strong open central aperture, an energetic slight diagonal displacement, clean negative space, not chain links, not a star. Integrate the symbol confidently with tall sharply cut lettering; custom Q terminal, controlled tight spacing, cultural-poster energy rather than a financial software logo. Clearly different silhouette from a lowercase sans wordmark or a soft serif wordmark. Color world: vivid signal scarlet #F52D42, true BLACK #101010, pure WHITE. Do not use cream, beige, copper, brown, terracotta or an existing website visual system. Clean landscape 3:2 presentation board. Upper 60 percent pure WHITE: very large scarlet symbol + black TASTIQ horizontal lockup. Lower left: solid SCARLET field with white standalone match symbol and a small white logo. Lower right: pure white with the SAME lockup strictly BLACK ONE-INK, plus small black standalone symbol. Simple red/black/white palette strip permitted. Repeated letterforms and symbol geometry must match precisely. Crisp flat vector-style artwork, generous clear space, no gradients/shadows/textures, no screenshots or app UI, no slogans or labels, no numbers. Text only TASTIQ. No play triangle, game controller, reel, checkmark, generic sparkle or speech bubble. Powerful small-scale symbol and distinct brand posture, not merely a recolored version of the other directions.
